AtomPub is a curated academic blog that accepts contributions from researchers
who don't have their own platform — or who want a second home for their work.
There is no formal peer review. The editor reads every submission and responds
within a week.

## What to submit

Any format that fits the AtomPub spirit: reading notes, op-eds, method write-ups,
short data observations, commentary. Length is flexible. Figures welcome.

The one technical requirement: write your piece as a `.qmd` file using the
[AtomPub Light template](https://github.com/AtomRearch/AtomPub/blob/main/journal/_extensions/atompub-light/template.qmd).
Every article gets a stable `AP-YYYY-slug` citation ID and a permanent URL.

## Two ways to submit

**Option A — GitHub PR (preferred)**

```bash
# 1. Fork https://github.com/AtomRearch/AtomPub
# 2. Drop your .qmd into journal/articles/your-slug.qmd
# 3. Open a pull request — title: "Submission: Your Article Title"
```

Include a `references.bib` and an OG image (`assets/og/your-slug.png`, 1200×630)
if you have them. Both are optional.

**Option B — Email**

Not familiar with `.qmd`? No problem — send your piece as plain text, Markdown,
or a Word document to [atomfeed@163.com](mailto:atomfeed@163.com).
We will handle the formatting on our end.

::: {.callout-note}
**No MSEDsBench anchor required.** No data-verification pipeline.
Just good writing and honest provenance.
:::

[Open a pull request →](https://github.com/AtomRearch/AtomPub/compare){.atp-btn .atp-btn--accent}
[Email your submission →](mailto:atomfeed@163.com){.atp-btn}
